name: @builderforce/sarif
description: THE SARIF 2.1.0 interchange (PRD 41 §C12): parse any tool's SARIF (Semgrep, CodeQL, ESLint) into the platform's NormalizedFinding and a richer per-result record (baselineState, partialFingerprints, snippet), and build SARIF logs for export. Pure, dependency-free and I/O-free: the Worker (api), run-delta and agent-tools run the same code. Source-only: its tests run in the API suite (api/vitest.config.ts collects every source-only package's src). The official 2.1.0 JSON schema is vendored under schema/ for run-delta's export test.
